data.name: Karamah
data.long_meaning: Arabic origin: كرامة (Karamah) – Generosity, Graciousness, Honour, Dignity. The root 'Karim' denotes nobility, kindness and generosity.
data.spiritual_meaning: A virtue and act of kindness and generosity towards others.

in_arabic.name: كرامة
in_arabic.meaning: كرامة تعني الشرف و العزة و الرفعة في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: كرامة هي كلمة مشتقة من الجذر العربي 'ك-ر-م' والذي يعني العطاء و الشرف. في الإسلام، كرامة تعني الشرف و العزة و الرفعة. وردت الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَمَن يُعظِم شعارَ اللهِ فَإِنَّهُ مِن قَبلِ قَلبِهِ' (الآية 139 من سورة آل عمران). تاريخيًا، كانت كرامة تعتبر من الصفات الرفيعة للإنسان المسلم، حيث تشير إلى كرامة الإنسان و عزته أمام الله و الناس.

in_urdu.name: کرامت
in_urdu.meaning: کرامت کا مطلب ہے عزت، شرافت اور بلند مرتبگی
in_urdu.long_meaning: کرامت عربی زبان کے جذر 'ک-ر-م' سے نکلی ہے جس کا مطلب ہے دینا اور شرافت. اسلامی روایت میں کرامت کا مطلب ہے عزت، شرافت اور بلند مرتبگی. جنوبی ایشیاء میں، کرامت کو مسلمانوں کے لئے ایک اہم صفت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے جو ان کی روحانی اور معاشرتی حیثیت کو ظاہر کرتی ہے.

in_hindi.name: करामत
in_hindi.meaning: करामत का अर्थ है सम्मान, शराफत और उच्च दर्जा
in_hindi.long_meaning: करामत अरबी भाषा के मूल 'क-र-म' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है देना और शराफत. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, करामत को एक महत्वपूर्ण आध्यात्मिक और सामाजिक गुण के रूप में देखा जाता है जो व्यक्ति की प्रतिष्ठा और गरिमा को दर्शाता है.

in_pashto.name: کرامت
in_pashto.meaning: کرامت معنی یې عزت، شرافت او لوړ رتبه ده
in_pashto.long_meaning: کرامت د عربي ژبې د ريښې 'ک-ر-م' څخه اخيستل شوې ده چې د ورکړې او شرافت معنی لري. په پښتني روايت کې، کرامت د يو مهم صفت په توګه ليدل کيږي چې د انسان عزت او شرافت په ګوته کوي.

in_english.name: Karamah
in_english.meaning: Karamah means honor, dignity, and nobility in Islamic tradition
in_english.long_meaning: Karamah originates from the Arabic root 'k-r-m' which signifies giving and nobility. In Islamic tradition, Karamah refers to honor, dignity, and nobility bestowed by Allah. The term is mentioned in the Quran and Hadith, emphasizing its significance in Islamic spirituality. Historically, Karamah has been a revered attribute in Muslim cultures, symbolizing a person's elevated status and moral character.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل کرامت (kah-RAH-mat)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل کرامت (kah-RAH-mat)

data.cultural_impact: The name "Karamah" holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic and Arab community for various reasons. In the Islamic tradition, acts of generosity and graciousness are virtues that are highly valued, and the name symbolizes these qualities. "Karamah" is often used to describe a person who is generous, kind, and respectful towards others. It highlights the importance of honor and dignity within society, which is a deeply embedded cultural value in Islamic and Arab communities. The name serves as a reminder of the Islamic virtues and ethical code of conduct emphasizing kindness, generosity, and respect towards others.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Karamah" lies in its connection to the generosity and kindness of Allah (God) towards His creation. In Islam, Allah is considered to be the Ultimate Giver, and the name "Karamah" symbolizes His infinite generosity and compassion towards His creation. The name serves as a reminder of the divine mercy and love of Allah towards mankind. Additionally, acts of "Karamah" or generosity and kindness towards others are seen as a reflection of the divine attributes of Allah and are considered to be pleasing to Him. Thus, the name "Karamah" holds both cultural and spiritual significance in the Islamic and Arab community, emphasizing the importance of generosity, kindness, respect, and dignity in daily life, as well as being a reminder of the infinite mercy and compassion of Allah towards His creation.
